threat_event: Attacker uses a cross-division identity or a division-managed laptop to enter a station business network and move toward CDA-adjacent systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,900 standing cross-division accounts; division laptops admitted by exception list with no device check; accounts removed a median of 46 days late
existing_controls: SYS-G1 MFA; EDR on station endpoints; one-way devices protect CDAs
treatment_plan: Assignment-bound access from the outage schedule; contractor network segment with device check; same-day removal at assignment end

threat_event: Compromise of the kiosk update path delivers malware toward CDAs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosk update server on the general station server subnet; update packages not signature-checked; 2 kiosks on unsupported OS
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-N6 kiosk update server; PMMD kiosks
existing_controls: Kiosks use two scanning engines; CST reviews kiosk logs weekly; CDAs at Level 3 and 4 behind one-way devices
treatment_plan: Signature verification on the server and at the kiosk; restricted segment; replace Station B kiosk OS; CAP entries

threat_event: Ransomware spreads through shared services and halts outage work, dosimetry, and waste operations at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared identity, WAN, and cloud platform connect all divisions
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR; PAM; immutable backups; CDAs not reachable from business networks
treatment_plan: Quarterly cross-division restore tests; WMS failover test; tiered admin model; cross-division tabletop (P08)

threat_event: CDA details or SGI held in business systems are exposed and give an adversary target information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CDA work packages readable by all WMS users; manual SGI screening; undocumented SGI need-to-know in Engineering; networked reproduction equipment
existing_controls: SGI on stand-alone systems; SGI training; DLP rules for SGI markings
treatment_plan: Restricted CDA module and cyber security sensitive label; automated SGI marking scan; need-to-know determinations; reproduction equipment re-evaluation

threat_event: A required notice is missed or late for an event that spans divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Group matrix lacks the FBI-triggered 4-hour NRC clock, CIP-008, Agreement State Part 37 reports, contract notices, and SEC timing in one place; never exercised
existing_controls: Station 73.77 procedures; group IR plan; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Complete the multi-regulator matrix (P08); cross-division tabletop; SOC trigger list

threat_event: Personal information of workers and monitored individuals is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contractor/vendor access authorization files on project shares; dosimetry portal admins without MFA
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; SOC monitoring
treatment_plan: Move access authorization files to a restricted repository; MFA for portal administrators

threat_event: Undocumented inheritance and policy drift hide control failures in the waste division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Waste inheritance matrix not done; supplement last aligned 2024
existing_controls: Group policies effective; annual attestation process exists
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix; re-issue supplement; attest
owner: Radioactive Waste Management security and compliance lead

threat_event: AI is used in maintenance or engineering decisions without nuclear-specific governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Predictive maintenance pilot not reviewed under 50.65 or 73.58; generative AI in engineering without QA rules
existing_controls: Group AI Standard adopted 2026; model outputs advisory
treatment_plan: Group AI program (P10): Maintenance Rule review, 73.58 screen, QA rules for engineering AI

threat_event: A critical third party is breached or unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EAM vendor, background investigation vendor, waste tracking and telematics vendors each serve several processes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-N2; SYS-W1; SYS-W4; background investigation vendor
existing_controls: Annual SOC 2 report reviews; contract breach terms
treatment_plan: Second background investigation vendor; continuous monitoring of tier 1 vendors

threat_event: An insider with legitimate access stages an attack from the business side
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business network administrators and cross-division staff have broad access; insider mitigation focuses on the protected area
existing_controls: 73.56 program for plant network administrators; behavior monitoring in SIEM
treatment_plan: Extend user behavior rules to cross-division accounts; review 73.56 population annually

threat_event: The SEC disclosure for a cyber incident is late or inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality inputs from three divisions and three regulators; no cross-division exercise
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter includes cyber; Item 106 disclosure
treatment_plan: Materiality factors in P08; tabletop with the disclosure committee

threat_event: A group identity platform outage stops business processes in all divisions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Every business system federates to SYS-G1
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts tested quarterly; CDAs and fleet operations center independent
treatment_plan: Add break-glass for the WMS clearance module; annual failover drill

threat_event: A widely used software supplier is compromised (identity, EDR, EAM)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same suppliers across divisions; automatic updates
existing_controls: Vendor assessments; staged updates for servers
treatment_plan: Update rings for EDR and agents; supplier incident playbook

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts Florida headquarters, Station A business facilities, and the Florida waste facility at once
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three key sites in one region
existing_controls: Provider B replicas; station emergency plans; remote work
treatment_plan: Regional failover plan for business services; pre-storm checklist across divisions

threat_event: Federal Contract Information is mishandled in DOE work
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two divisions hold DOE contracts with FAR 52.204-21
existing_controls: Enclave for engineering work
treatment_plan: Use the enclave model for the waste division DOE project

threat_event: Pending NRC proposals are treated as current and controls are dropped early
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule 91 FR 38928 would change 73.77 and RG 5.71; staff discuss it as if final
existing_controls: Regulatory affairs tracks rulemakings
treatment_plan: Regulatory change log; no CSP or procedure change until a final rule and license basis change

threat_event: Default credentials and unmanaged devices on station and facility networks are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Printers and OT devices outside the identity platform; default passwords found in P07
affected_asset_or_process: Station multifunction printers; waste facility OT
existing_controls: Weekly credentialed scans of servers and endpoints
treatment_plan: Default credential scans for all network devices; device onboarding checklist

threat_event: Attackers try to reach the NERC CIP fleet operations center through corporate services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared corporate network next to the Electronic Security Perimeter
existing_controls: Separate ESP and identity store; interactive remote access through an intermediate system with MFA
treatment_plan: Annual ESP review with group internal audit; SOC rules for attempts against EACMS

threat_event: Key cyber staff (CST, SOC) leave and are hard to replace
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small specialist pools; CST members need 73.56 authorization and plant knowledge
existing_controls: Retention bonuses; cross-training
treatment_plan: Succession plans; shared rotation between SOC and CSTs

threat_event: Part 810 technology is reached by an unauthorized foreign person through engineering collaboration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Collaboration platform is shared with external clients and foreign national staff
existing_controls: Export-controlled folders and access list
treatment_plan: Quarterly access recertification for export-controlled folders
